summary: Round 39 plan check (light; local reads only, 0 Kaggle calls). Every R38 arm is alive and matches its logged text: pre_exp89t 17:40Z, manual-admit 19:44:45Z, the exp89t watcher, card v3 ae03f566 and the timers. The edges 19:12:17Z/19:45:17Z are correct, and the slot-2 default UNUSED is consistent. Five gaps remain in the evening chain: (1) nothing triggers the R38-A5 T7 check at the first header >= 19:12:17Z (~19:20:30Z); arm a local watcher. (2) The 18:37Z/19:43Z/21:05Z timer texts would push a user who ticked the allowed trade П2 back to П3; log a comparator line. (3) After 12:00Z the rounds' e10_snapshot.py runs (8 API calls each) have no actionable use and overlap the 17:40-19:45Z saves and the single-attempt manual list; switch to Chrome only and skip or retarget the 18:13Z round. (4) The 18:37Z card is not pre-built, and the v3 text goes stale; script its variants before 17:40Z. (5) The pre_exp89t S0 needs a count-56 validity guard. No build, no slot-2 file, no rule rewrite.

findings.what: R38-A5 T7 has no trigger. The playbook codes T7 at 'the first header >= 19:12:17Z' with exp89t still PENDING. It then sends a push, and for SELECTED (c)/(d) a 'tick П3 now' line. Nothing is armed for that moment. The alive timers jump from the 18:37Z FINAL card to the 19:43Z TICK REMINDER, and the exp89t watcher (win 30864) fires only on COMPLETE/ERROR. The 18:13Z hourly round is not a trigger. If exp89t is still running at 19:12Z (L > 10.2 h, the CI tail), the T7 message arrives only at 19:43Z. The user, who may still have {#37, #38} ticked, then gets 17 min instead of ~40 min before 23:00 MSK.

The poller cadence is 601-603 s from 11:08:50Z, so headers fall at ~19:10:2xZ and ~19:20:3xZ (+-1 min): the first header >= 19:12:17Z is ~19:20:30Z (22:20 MSK). The ledger CI family L is 8.88-9.48 h. The tail up to ~10.9 h is logged in the 09:00Z entry.
findings.action: Before 18:13Z, arm one local background job (0 Kaggle calls) in the same style as pre_exp89t.sh: '. scratchpad/lastok.sh; T=$(date -u -d 2026-09-29T19:12:17Z +%s); until h=$(grep "^=== " experiments/lb_poll/poll.log | grep -v "empty stdout" | tail -1 | cut -c5-24); [ "$(date -u -d "$h" +%s)" -ge "$T" ]; do sleep 30; done; echo "T7 CHECK header $h"; lastok | grep -E "^56669888," | grep -oE "SubmissionStatus[.][A-Z]+,[0-9.]*"'. If it prints PENDING, send the R38-A5 (6) T7 text at once, after 1 SELECTED read. If it is terminal, the watcher/read path already handles it and the output is ignored. Log one line in CONTEXT: 'T7 trigger armed, local, first non-error header >= 19:12:17Z'.

findings.what: The 18:37Z / 19:43Z / 21:05Z timer texts check SELECTED against 'the recommended pair' and push 'if not the recommended pair'. R38-A5 then appends 'RECOMMENDED PAIR = П3 {...}' after a promotion. The trade П2 {V_pub, exp75} is inside the user's agreed plan (16:32Z 28 Sep: V_pub + #37 or exp75). Card v3 l.50 promises only to message 'если отмечено не то, что вы выбрали'. So a user who ticks П2 on purpose would be pushed back to П3 at 22:43 MSK and again at 00:05 MSK, once by each timer. That contradicts the card and the R38-A5 T4/T7 (b) texts ('П2 — допустимый обмен, менять не обязательно'). No CONTEXT line defines the comparator.
findings.evidence: Timer texts via /proc cmdline. 30986: 'give the user the exact untick/tick steps for the recommended pair'. 30992: 'if not the recommended pair, message/push the user'. 30996: 'if not the recommended pair, message/push the user the exact pair'. Scratchpad card_fill_1203_v3.txt l.24, l.26, l.50. grep 'LAST CALL|TICK REMINDER|RECOMMENDED PAIR' in CONTEXT finds only l.4533 (the R38-A5 append).
findings.action: One CONTEXT line at the 12:00Z entry (a bookkeeping clarification of existing texts, not a rule change): 'SELECTED CHECK COMPARATOR (18:37Z/19:43Z/21:05Z): no push iff SELECTED = exactly 2 refs = {V_pub, #37 56563521} or {V_pub, exp75 56656157}, where V_pub = the running champion after any exp89t promotion. If the user named a pair in chat, only that pair passes. Otherwise push the exact untick/tick: to П3 by default, or to П2 if the user chose П2 and only the V_pub member is stale.' Treat the three timer texts as pointers to this line.

findings.what: After 12:00Z each round's browser scan still runs tools/e10_snapshot.py once: 8 CLI calls (5 kernel lists, 2 statuses, 1 full LB download). That is ~40 calls across rounds 40-44 (13:13-18:13Z), and the 17:13Z/18:13Z rounds overlap the calls that must not hit a 429: the 17:40Z pre_exp89t save, the exp89t read with its post_exp89t save and _b lag re-save (typical 18:17-18:29Z), and the single-attempt 19:44:45Z manual-admit list. After 12:00Z these snapshots give no actionable E10 (R38-A2 (d): no file can read before the tick). Chrome's Code tab (sorted by score / recently created) detects a flag with 0 API calls. The 18:13Z generic round also competes with the exp89t read and the 18:37Z card for the session's attention.

findings.what: No card is pre-built for 18:37Z, and the 12:03Z v3 text goes stale by then. At 21:37 MSK, l.3 would still say 'карточка на 15:03 МСК', and l.48 would still say 'чтение ожидается ~20:55–21:30 МСК', a window that has passed. If exp89t has been read (likely: CI L 8.88-9.48 h puts it at 17:53-18:29Z), the card needs the R38-A5 'filled card' edits: the exp89t token row, V_CI, the neighbour line, the П3 hedge list, the DIS line and the UNPROVEN-ins suffix. Writing these by hand in the ~10-20 min after the read, while an UP test may be running, invites token errors of the PC38-01 type. After 12:00Z the only rank source is pre_exp89t (17:40Z). On a T1 read of 0.960 no LB save is planned, so the rank in the card header would be stale.

findings.what: The pre_exp89t S0 has no validity guard. pre_exp89t.sh saves at 17:40Z whenever the newest non-error poller block still shows exp89t PENDING. If exp89t completed between that header (~17:3xZ) and the 17:40Z download, the S0 already contains the new best (count 57, rank possibly risen). The T3 test would then see an S0-to-S1 count of +0. That triggers a spurious lag re-save and ends in BLIND/k = 0, so a genuine UP is lost and exp87a stays. R38-A5 says 'S0 = pre_exp89t, else e10 fallback' but defines 'else' only as a missing file, not an invalid one.
findings.evidence: The pre_exp89t.sh body (scratchpad) has no count check; it greps only 'SubmissionCount' for success. R37-A3 requires count 56 -> 57. The CI L minimum on experiments/lb_poll/ledger.md is 8.88 h (exp75), and 17:40Z = L 8.66 h, so the odds are low (~1-3%) but nonzero. The e10 fallback (20260929T1110Z or 1141Z) has count 56.
findings.action: Log one line pre-score, before 17:40Z: 'pre_exp89t is a valid S0 only if our row shows SubmissionCount 56 and LastSubmissionDate 2026-09-29 00:46:36. Otherwise (57, or a changed date) use the e10_<ts> fallback flagged stale, and state it in the T3 log.' Apply it by hand when reading the 17:40Z job output. No script change is needed.
